project.name: KHKD - Mantis Shrimp Tom Tit Cu Dam Soi Nuoc
project.description: Vietnamese science-horror Reel — tom tit mantis shrimp cu dam tao bong bong soi 4400 do C
project.story: The peacock mantis shrimp (Odontodactylus scyllarus) has the fastest punch in the animal kingdom. Its club-shaped raptorial appendage accelerates at 80 km/h, faster than a 22-caliber bullet leaving its barrel. The strike happens so fast underwater that it creates a cavitation bubble that briefly reaches around 4400°C — hotter than the surface of the sun — and emits a flash of visible light called sonoluminescence. Its eyes have 16 different photoreceptors (humans have 3), seeing colors we cannot imagine.

characters.name: Peacock Mantis Shrimp

characters.name: Crab Shell Prey

characters.name: Cavitation Bubble Flash
characters.description: Brilliant glowing white-hot cavitation bubble formed in water at the moment of mantis shrimp strike, surrounded by shockwave ripples, emitting visible sonoluminescent light flash.

characters.name: Coral Reef Habitat
characters.description: Tropical shallow coral reef with sand bottom, vivid orange and purple coral, turquoise water, gentle sun rays piercing from surface above.

Vivid colors of the shrimp glow under cool blue water. Vertical macro framing, dramatic action moment.

The camera holds tight on the bright explosion moment. Vivid colors of the shrimp glow against cool blue water, dramatic underwater contrast.
